ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

content-carousel.description: Rotating panel for arbitrary projected content with align/divider sides and keyboard support.

chrome.note: Pick how much chrome the panel shows: nothing, arrows alone, or dots alone. Keyboard always keeps working.

dividers.note: Centered content earns a divider on both sides. Top and bottom alignments flip the divider to the opposite edge.

examples.label: Login highlights
examples.note: Static login form on the left, rotating highlights on the right with a divider between them. Use the arrows or dots to move, or focus the viewport and use the arrow keys.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the component and the slide directive.

login.qr: QR code placeholder for app sign-in
login.text: Use your phone to approve this session, or keep exploring the rotating highlights.
login.title: Welcome back

mega-panel.label: Featured content
mega-panel.note: Featured slot without a divider: the carousel fits any box and never sizes itself.

progress.label: Rotating announcements
progress.note: With progress navigation and autoplay, the active dot fills over the duration, then the carousel advances. The fill pauses on hover, focus, hidden tabs, and reduced motion.

promo.label: Promotions
promo.note: Same slot, different promo components. Below 360px the vertical divider flips to the bottom so a stacked panel keeps the separation legible.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.
